description: Ministry of Labour - Special Allowances in Cocoa, Cardamom & Pepper Trade
categorisation: This gazette notification announces a special allowance for workers in specific agricultural trades based on the Cost of Living Index Number. It falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) as it deals with public sector service conditions and benefits, specifically wage adjustments and allowances for workers, issued by the Commissioner General of Labour under the Wages Boards Ordinance.
